  "notes": "Termination rates are published by Service only for Safety groups (Police, Fire, Muni Drivers, Craft) in Table B-3 (Page 69) and by Age and Service for Miscellaneous in Table B-2 (Page 68). The target grid requires a single rate per cell. Since the document provides distinct rates for different employee groups (Safety vs Misc) and the target does not specify a group, and no headcount table is provided to weight them, the extraction defaults to the Miscellaneous group (Table B-2) as it is the largest and most detailed group with Age x Service data. The Safety rates (Table B-3) are by Service only and would require a broadcast assumption of 'age' independence which is not explicitly stated for Safety (though implied by the table structure). However, Table B-2 explicitly provides Age x Service for Misc. The mapping uses the Misc table. For Safety groups, the rates are constant by age for a given service (Table B-3), so a broadcast of 'age' would apply the service rate to all ages. Since the target asks for 'Sep_Rate' without group specification, and Misc is the default 'general' group in many contexts, Misc is selected. Note: Target service bins 6, 8, 10, 11, 12, 30, 40 all map to the source bin '5 or more' (op copy) as the source does not differentiate beyond 5 years. Target ages 25-70 map to the source age rows (25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, 65) via copy. Age 70 is not explicitly in Table B-2 (last row 65), so it is mapped to the 65 row (or 65+ if implied, but here 65 is the last row). The source values are percentages and will be converted to decimals by the code."
